Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: World Bank (2025) recommends setting up online business registry. Current status: not yet integrated. Some progress toward online business services but no cross-government data exchange.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Fetched the cited World Bank article (accurate but single-source) and found fresher evidence: the Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS), live since 21 July 2025 under EIPA/Ministry of Commerce, already links trading-licence applications with ERS TIN issuance and Home Affairs permits, and the trade portal confirms online company name-search/reservation/payment/registration has existed since 2020. This is real, if partial, cross-agency integration rather than a mere plan, so the score is upgraded from 2 (Planned) to 3 (Under development).

Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Civil registration system records births, deaths, marriages, divorces. UNDP DRA notes mixed expert assessment of digital transformation of civil registration. Not integrated into a data exchange platform.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The UNDP DRA source is confirmed as accurate for 2024, but is now dated: UNECA (2022) documents active work linking birth/death registration to the population register, and Jembi (reported January 2026) confirms the Population Registry — fed by CRVS data — is now technically integrated into the health sector's Master Patient Index via FHIR for real-time patient identification. This is genuine progress beyond 'Planned', so upgraded to 3 (Under development); flagged for human review because the confirmed integration is currently health-sector-specific rather than a general cross-government exchange.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: UNDP DRA notes significant progress in digitizing tax and utility services (tax represents 22.4% of digital G2C services). Tax services are among the most advanced digital services in Eswatini but integration with a cross-government exchange platform is not yet established.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. The Eswatini Revenue Service's TaxEase portal (operational since March 2024, Oracle-based) provides online filing/payment for PAYE, VAT, CIT and PIT, and the 2025 BOSS one-stop shop now links ERS TIN issuance to other agencies — but no cross-government data exchange platform yet integrates tax data centrally. Score 3 (Under development) remains appropriate; value code unchanged.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: World Bank Digital Eswatini project includes social registries as a DPI component. G2P payments integration planned. Current status is planned/under development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: A World Bank project appraisal document (P507360) confirms an MIS-based Eswatini Social Registry ('Imbeleko') is being built with 'built-in quality control and interoperability mechanisms', and local reporting (June 2026) confirms a Shiselweni pilot has already registered 44,683 of an estimated 47,766 households. This is beyond 'Planned', so upgraded to 3 (Under development); full national rollout and cross-government use are not yet complete.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Data Protection Act 2022 provides legal framework for data collection, processing and cross-border flows. Computer Crime and Cyber Crime Act 2022 complements this. However, no specific law mandating cross-government data sharing/interoperability yet. World Bank project and roadmap development are the next steps.
redteam_note: Comment wording may not match the score — re-read (needs judgement).
revision_notes: Read the Data Protection Act 2022 and the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 2022 in full text: neither establishes authority for cross-government data sharing or governs a data exchange system — they cover personal data protection and e-transactions/e-signatures/e-government service delivery respectively. The World Bank's Digital Eswatini project (concept stage, June 2025) still lists 'data interoperability/exchange' as infrastructure yet to be built. The red-team flag is upheld: the Comments already stated no specific enabling law exists, contradicting the Value Code of 3 (Yes). Corrected to 2 (Under development).
